summary_text: In March 2026, the user purchased fresh, unbranded vegetables across eight independent dates. The core cooking staples Onion, Baby Potato, and Coriander Leaves appeared on four or more dates, indicating high-confidence stable preferences. Carrot, Beetroot, Lemon, Local Tomato, Sweet Potato, French Beans, Mint Leaves, Green Capsicum, Cluster Beans, and Brinjal Bharta appeared on two dates, indicating medium-confidence stable preferences. The morning daypart was the most frequent ordering window, appearing on four independent dates. Other dayparts (afternoon, evening, night) appeared on single dates.
